market_outlook.short_term: Risk-off bias dominates: oil spike from Iran strikes, rising Fed rate bets, and Treasury selloff pressure equities. S&P 500 slips; crypto and precious metals under pressure. EM is the bright spot. Expect elevated volatility through September as geopolitical uncertainty persists and rate expectations reprice.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally intact but is segmenting into winners and laggards. EM rotation and Japan logistics/infrastructure investment suggest global capital reallocation. GLP-1-driven consumer shifts and generational trust erosion create structural retail opportunities. Higher-for-longer rates favor financials and short-duration credit over growth.
